## 1. Core Formula
```text
Net Equitable Split = (Marital Assets - Marital Debts) * State Guideline Factor; Alimony = (Higher Earner Net - Lower Earner Net) * 25%-35%
```

## 2. Worked Numerical Example (2026)
10-year marriage with $420,000 home equity ($180k mortgage) and $160,000 401(k) yields $200,000 net equity per spouse before QDRO retirement split fees ($600-$1,200).
